data.desc: Arbe (NASDAQ: ARBE), a global leader in ultra-high-resolution radar solutions, is redefining radar as a core sensing platform for next-generation mobility and defense. Arbe's complete radar technology stack, from proprietary chipsets to radar systems and AI algorithms that produce perception-ready data, delivers the detail and real-time processing that demanding sensing applications require. Arbe enables OEMs, Tier-1s, and defense integrators to build more capable perception systems for passenger vehicles, robotaxis, heavy machinery, and counter-drone systems. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, Arbe also operates offices in the United States, Germany, and China.
